metrics_are: descriptive GT-level saved-mask diagnostics, not causal AP gains

methods.small: noncrowd/nonignored original GT mask area <=1024 pixels; keep all small GT
methods.partition: Independent best same/other-class IoU among saved official top100. First same>=.75, then same>=.5, then other>=.5, then any>=.1, otherwise no overlap. Exclusive and exhaustive, not one-to-one.
methods.matched: Existing COCO all-area per-class greedy score-ordered matches, filtered to small GT afterwards; distinct from area-specific COCO AP-small.
methods.extent: For independent max-IoU SAME-class saved mask: intersection/pred-area and intersection/GT-area. Shape/extent errors, not contour metric or proven feature-resolution cause.
methods.scores: Fixed score .5 diagnostic slice only; not a selected production threshold. Score combines class and mask quality; no separate logits or stable query IDs exist here.
methods.scale: Approximate bbox scaling from frozen eval short_edge800/max_size1333; no inference or train augmentation simulation.
methods.cases: One deterministic deliberately chosen example per failure/change mode; not representative performance sampling.
